title_zh: 约定先恢复短时间钢琴练习

scenario.label_zh: 商定恢复钢琴练习的一小步
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论挫败感并约定一段可坚持的练习及分享安排

context_zh: 成年人佩特拉因停练许久而沮丧，与朋友约瑟夫讨论恢复钢琴练习。
author: author-phase08-b

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: I sit at the piano and expect to master the whole piece again. Then I stop after the first mistake.

sentences.speaker: Josef
sentences.text: Would working on just four bars make it easier to begin?

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Maybe. I don't have much motivation after work.

sentences.speaker: Josef
sentences.text: What used to motivate you: playing for someone, or hearing your own progress?

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: Hearing a phrase become smoother. I could spend ten minutes on those four bars instead of struggling through everything.

sentences.speaker: Josef
sentences.text: That sounds easier to maintain than an hour you never have time for.

sentences.speaker: Petra
sentences.text: I'll try ten minutes after dinner on Monday and Wednesday. Could I play the phrase for you next weekend?

sentences.speaker: Josef
sentences.text: I'd like that. We can listen for what feels easier, not count mistakes.
